mcp_tools.name: delivery_plan_preparation
mcp_tools.title: Delivery plan preparation
mcp_tools.description: Submits a delivery-plan manifest (framing and approval, declared phases, milestones, estimation, risks, decisions, execution discipline, status) and returns a deterministic DELIVERY_PLAN_READY / DELIVERY_PLAN_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed schedule-arithmetic, dependency-resolution and coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared plan; it writes no plan.

inputSchema.description: The delivery-plan manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and phase/milestone/risk/decision row schemas).

phases.description: Declared phases: {name, owner, exit_criteria_declared, start_date, end_date, depends_on, size, assumptions_declared}.

decisions.description: Declared decision-log entries: {date, decision, rationale_declared, alternatives_declared}.

expect.notes: Full valid manifest per SERVICE.md; computed quantities in structured spot checks.

dependencies: every name in a phase's declared depends_on list names a phase the plan declares

quality gate: risks have triggers — every declared risk row declares a trigger
risk register: the register is reviewed each phase
estimate honestly: sizes come with assumptions listed — every declared phase row declares its assumptions
estimate honestly: the least-known item is flagged as the top risk
decision log: the declared plan record names its decision-log entries — the decisions list is present and non-empty
decision log: every entry carries the skill's log shape — a valid date, the decision, a declared rationale and declared alternatives considered
decision log: the log is append-only
quality gate: decisions are logged when made, not reconstructed later
WIP limit: a work-in-progress limit is declared — finish phases, don't parallelize beyond capacity
WIP limit: one worked item per lane
red line: plan updates go through approval

status: blockers are reported
status: confidence is reported
